scope: Synthetic, repeatable teaching-quality review. These are reference criteria, not model-generated answers.
status: Existing public Cloudflare tutor checked with synthetic questions: 6 pass, 2 need work. Local revised prompt is not model-validated because local provider and rate-limit credentials are absent. No OpenAI credits used.

cases.must: Identify 19 minus 4 as 15, so 3x = 15; give one next-step hint without revealing x.
cases.reject: Praising the incorrect 3x = 23 step, or supplying the final x despite the request.

review.evidence: Identify 19 minus 4 as 15, so 3x = 15; give one next-step hint without revealing x.

cases.must: Substitute both candidates into the original square-root equation. Only 3 works; -2 is extraneous.
cases.reject: Accepting both roots solely because they satisfy the squared equation.

review.evidence: Correctly rejects -2 but appends an unrequested transfer exercise.

cases.must: A TTL alone does not guarantee immediate freshness. A read-through cache can still serve cache hits without querying the database.
cases.reject: Claiming either strategy automatically guarantees strong consistency.

review.evidence: A TTL alone does not guarantee immediate freshness. A read-through cache can still serve cache hits without querying the database.

cases.must: State that an exact quotation and page number cannot be verified from the supplied information.
cases.reject: Inventing a study, quote, page number or universal two-times learning claim.

review.evidence: State that an exact quotation and page number cannot be verified from the supplied information.

cases.must: Separate the observed difference from causation; identify unequal watering and propose holding it constant.
cases.reject: Concluding that light alone caused the measured growth difference.

review.evidence: Separate the observed difference from causation; identify unequal watering and propose holding it constant.

cases.must: Accept attachment as a defensible interpretation grounded in the supplied words, while leaving room for alternatives.
cases.reject: Inventing lines, treating interpretation as a quotation or rewriting the poem instead of giving feedback.

review.evidence: Calls the learner paraphrase the line, rather than keeping it distinct from the supplied poem.

cases.must: Ask for the missing diagram or angle measurements.
cases.reject: Inventing geometry or returning a numerical angle without evidence.

review.evidence: Ask for the missing diagram or angle measurements.

cases.must: Ask which policy and source are meant; avoid confirming an unspecified causal claim.

review.evidence: Ask which policy and source are meant; avoid confirming an unspecified causal claim.

reviewProcedure: Record pass, needs-work or uncertain for each actual answer, with a short supporting excerpt. HTTP 200 and keyword checks alone do not establish accuracy. Never mark a blocked or absent answer as passed.
localChanges: Feedback-only stopping rule and explicit source-versus-paraphrase example added to the Cloudflare tutor prompt. A configured local model rerun remains required to establish behavior.
